_doc: Safe-zone Market (B): what it sells and its wording. Each row has a quantity slider and one trade button. Prices come from js/items/economy.js (safe-zone markup to buy, sell rate and market saturation to sell). Quest items are never sold. Outside a safe zone the panel becomes a summon errand (data/errand.json).

closed.en: Markets open in a safe zone (Barracks, Citadel or a camp)
